description: Create a group of portal users and set its access rights on forms/reports. Use it after create_portal. Call set_table_permission with portal_group_id for rights on a particular table, or pass tables_permissions right here.

is_default.description: true = this group is the default one for new sign-ups in the portal

tables_permissions.description: Access rights on tables/reports. They need not be passed here; they can be added later through set_table_permission with portal_group_id

only_own_records.description: true: people of this group see only the records they added or were made owner of. For a group of people from OUTSIDE the owner's business — clients, tenants, students, patients, suppliers — pass true unless the person said these people see everyone's records: one client must not read another's. For the owner's own staff leave it out unless the person asked. Tell the person which of the two you set.

role.description: 1=administrator: everything, as the owner; 2=read only; 3=read, write and DELETE records; 4=read, write and DELETE records, and build forms; 5=read and write records, NO delete; 6=read, edit and DELETE records; 7=read and edit records, NO delete. When the person asked that these people cannot delete, pass only a role that says NO delete (or read only), never one that says DELETE; and tell the person what the role lets them do in these words.

name: create_portal_group
